content: In this paper, we have analyzed various ways to integrate monolingual data in an NMT framework, focusing on their impact on quality and domain adaptation. While confirming the effectiveness of BT, our study also proposed significantly cheaper ways to improve the baseline performance, using a slightly modified copy of the target, instead of its full BT. When no high quality BT is available, using GANs to make the pseudo-source sentences closer to natural source sentences is an efficient solution for domain adaptation.
